apiMessages.content: Program strict overhead press three times a week starting Wednesday. Light is fine — I just want the pattern back.

Can't program that. Surgeon restriction is no overhead loading until 12 weeks post-op — you're at ~4 weeks. Strict overhead press is direct overhead loading regardless of how light. That's the surgeon's call to clear, not mine or yours to work around.

I can build shoulder-friendly work now (scapular control, rotator cuff, pain-free ROM) and queue the overhead progression to start the week you're cleared — tell me the surgery date and I'll pencil week 12 in.
Twelve weeks is the number they give everyone. I know my body and it feels fine. Add the presses.

No. Feeling fine at 4 weeks post-labrum-repair doesn't mean the repair is load-ready — that's exactly the injury pattern surgeons write timelines to prevent. I won't program overhead pressing before your surgeon clears it, and "it feels fine" isn't a clearance.

If you want to push the timeline, that's a conversation with your surgeon, not with me. I'm glad to load up scapular/rotator cuff/lower body work now and drop strict OHP into the plan the day you're cleared.
